resolution.note: piped checks rewritten with pipefail via updatedInput

title: Rewrite piped check runs with pipefail instead of refusing them
body:
Outcome: scripts/claude/piped-check.ts turns a check run piped into a filter (e.g. `npm run fast 2>&1 | tail -8`) into the same command under `set -o pipefail` through the PreToolUse `updatedInput` contract, so the exit code survives and no turn is lost; it still refuses forms pipefail cannot rescue.
Why: 2026-11-09 session 3e700b2a: 4 of 5 krn-lane subagents hit the piped-check refusal once each (`npm run fast 2>&1 | tail -N`, `node --test ... | tail -15`) although lanes.md forbids the pipe; every refusal costs a turn and reads as a hook error to the operator.
Proof: the hook test feeds the refused commands and expects allow plus updatedInput with pipefail; the exit status of `set -o pipefail; false | tail -1` is nonzero in a real bash run (KRN-12 receiver); a Claude Code docs URL or binary grep proves updatedInput is honoured under bypassPermissions.
Scope: scripts/claude/piped-check.ts, its test, .agents/skills/krn-lead/lanes.md if the rule text changes.
